summary: Typosquat of @tailwindcss/forms executes obfuscated loader that fetches next-stage payload via Ethereum RPC
details: The package name resembles @tailwindcss/forms. Its main entry src/index.js ships a legitimate-looking tailwind plugin followed by an obfuscator.io-encoded payload (301-entry rotating string array with a decoder wrapper and control-flow flattening). Decoded fragments reveal node:child_process, node:zlib createBrotliDecompress, and Ethereum JSON-RPC calls (eth_getBlockByNumber with block=99999999) against h.drpc.org, h.blockscout, and public.blastapi endpoints, with a custom X-Payload-* header and a browser-impersonating User-Agent. The loader runs on require() of the package's main file: the obfuscated code retrieves a next-stage payload smuggled through Ethereum RPC responses, brotli-decompresses it, and hands it to child_process for execution on the installer's host. This yields arbitrary code execution at import time on any machine that installs or loads this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
